translations.name: NJ Congregate Senior Meals (ADRC)
translations.description: NJ Congregate Senior Meals serve people 60 and older and their spouses. There is no income limit, and no one is refused for being unable to contribute. Call ADRC at 1-877-222-3737, and they will connect you with your county Office on Aging. There are over 200 sites open 5 or more days a week. It can take about a week.
translations.website_description: Find out how to get food help.
